properties.description:
Four tests in `crates/reflow2-core/tests/registering_the_file_that_is_a_check_gives_it_an_executable_form.rs`: an IMPLEMENTS edge is drawn; the wrong edge (REALIZES) is not; ONE call is enough for `capabilities_verified_by_runnable_check` to count the capability; and registering a file against a CAPABILITY still realizes it and grows no IMPLEMENTS, so the 400-odd artifacts already registered that way are untouched.

The third is the one that would have caught the original defect — it asserts the user-visible consequence rather than the edge, and every other signal in the design read green while the answer was wrong.

OBSERVED FAILING first: three of the four red, the fourth (the unchanged half) green from the start.

RE-RUN: `cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --test registering_the_file_that_is_a_check_gives_it_an_executable_form`.
properties.findings: 4/4 green 2026-09-22 after three were observed red. The fix moved this design's own record: executable forms 30 -> 71, capabilities verified by a runnable check 22 -> 58, checks with a registered file and no form 40 -> 0.
properties.name: One link_artifact call against a Verification leaves the check re-runnable, and draws no REALIZES
